jobs.summary:
Robert Half are partnering with a client in the Milford Haven area for a Business Solutions Analyst.
Key Responsibilities
Engage stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and discovery sessions to identify business needs and opportunities.
